messages:
Mira (People Ops): FYI everyone  the LON hub experienced an elevator outage this morning. Building ops say repairs might take 24-36 hrs. Were putting fallback plans in place for anyone who cant access upper floors or has mobility needs. Please read and RSVP for coworking if you need it.

Owen (Facilities): Confirmed  the main elevator is out of service due to hydraulic failure. Engineers estimate 24-36h. Fire stairs are fine but not suitable for some folks. Weve arranged temporary desks in two nearby coworking spaces (30 total desks) and a shuttle loop.

Zara (Security): Safety note: until elevator is back, badge access to floors 4-7 will be restricted to employees who have no mobility needs and can use stairs. If you have mobility constraints, please DO NOT use the stairs; book coworking via the People Ops link.

Mira (People Ops): Quick Q/A:
- Who is eligible for coworking? All LON-based staff and anyone due to be onsite today who cannot access their floor safely.
- Cost? Redwood covers coworking for today and tomorrow; bring receipts if you are at a different location and need reimbursement.
- Shuttle? Yes  see Owen's schedule below.

Owen (Facilities): Shuttle loop (today & tomorrow) 
```
09:00 / 09:40 / 10:20 pickup outside LON Central Station
12:30 / 13:15 / 14:00 return from Cowork Hub -> LON Office
Capacity: 10 ppl per run (book via DeskReserve -> "LON Elevator Shuttle")
```
If you need a wheelchair-accessible ride, DM Facilities and Security will prioritize one seat.

Mira (People Ops): Childcare/guest policy: if you're bringing a caregiver or guest to a cowork space while onsite, please list them in the RSVP; guests must wear visitor badge.

Zara (Security): If you have company equipment on upper floors and need it for critical work, contact Facilities with the asset tag list. We will arrange escorted transfers during scheduled windows (12:00-12:30 & 16:30-17:00).

Owen (Facilities): For those who prefer to stay in the building and can use stairs, weve set up temporary hot desks on the 3rd floor (capacity 18). Sanitation station and extra chairs added. Please keep backpacks light  no heavy lifting on stairs.

Mira (People Ops): Meal coverage: If you relocate to coworking, well cover one lunch up to A315 (GBP). Save receipt and submit under "office-fallback" tag. If you remain in-building but miss lunch due to mobility constraints, ping People Ops and we'll arrange delivery.

Zara (Security): Accessibility reminder: if you have medical equipment or need ground-floor access for the next 48 hrs, DM Security immediately so we can prioritize space and keys.

Employee (Sam): Is the WFH option allowed for today? I have a heavy crate I need to move to my desk so stairs are hard.

Mira (People Ops): Yes, WFH is allowed for anyone who cannot safely do the stairs and either coworking spaces are full or transportation isn't feasible. Managers: be flexible. Log exceptions on the People Ops portal.

Employee (Jules): Im hosting a vendor at 15:00 today on 6th floor  can they still come?

Zara (Security): External visitors discouraged while elevator is down. If vendor visit is essential, reschedule or move the meeting to a cowork space or 3rd-floor meeting room. Contact Security for a visitor badge and escort.

Owen (Facilities): TL;DR shuttle + coworking spots available, hot desks on 3rd floor for stair-capable folks, asset escort windows at 12:00 & 16:30, meal reimbursement up to A315, WFH allowed if needed. Repairs ETA 24-36h. Book via: https://intranet.redwood/deskreserve?event=1801234567

CalendarBot: Incident created "LON Elevator Outage  Coworking Fallback" by Mira. RSVP and shuttle signups on office page.

Mira (People Ops): Please RT to folks you know who were planning to be onsite. Well post an update when the elevator is back. Thanks for being flexible. :heart:
